LinkOS needs access to the local network to discover and connect with your Android companion device.
LinkOS uses Bluetooth Low Energy for proximity presence detection and auto-lock features.
LinkOS requires Screen Recording permission to stream your Mac desktop screen to your paired Android device for Remote Desktop.
LinkOS requires Accessibility permission to simulate wireless trackpad gestures, mouse clicks, and keyboard shortcuts from your phone.
LinkOS requires Microphone permission for real-time audio streaming.
